propositions: Pass-2 verification rejects all indices as unexpected when Pass-1 produces zero findings, degrading the entire batch to INDETERMINATE severity

The contract violation occurs because verify_instructions() returns an imperative sentence for an empty batch instead of an empty array directive, causing the verifier to return indices 0..N-1 against an empty findings list

An empty batch sent to the verify kernel triggers index-basis mismatch: the kernel synthesizes one empty chunk and sends one request with no index domain, but the verifier responds with indices that all fail validation

INDETERMINATE findings from the Pass-2 path cannot block on a decision; they can only flip PASS to INDETERMINATE when no advisory surfaces, so affected runs passed with unverified findings rather than spuriously blocking
The fix changes verify_instructions() to return EMPTY_BATCH_INSTRUCTIONS for empty batches, mirroring the contract prerequisite_workflow_ops already enforces

The deterministic regression test test_verify_empty_batch_contract.py reproduces and verifies the fix; the zero-finding production scenario (1% of historical runs) is covered by unit tests rather than live re-runs
